title: Kawagoe-Traditional Japanese Town near Tokyo 【え？同じ誕生日？】ワンデー小江戸・川越トリップでセレブレーション！
description:
A visit to Kawagoe, a traditional Japanese town famous for its well-preserved buildings from the past, that transports you back to the samurai days. Today we show you some of our favorite spots in this amazing place including a famous bean store, awesome soba lunch and one of the best places to buy Sayama Tea.
